diagnostic_title: End-to-End T0-T3 Feature Flow & Invariance Diagnostic Report

factor_1_missing_local_practice_data.finding: 33 of 34 standard weekends had zero raw practice JSON files in data/raw/openf1/practice/.
factor_1_missing_local_practice_data.evidence: Only session 9461 (Abu Dhabi 2024 FP1), 9656 (FP2), 9657 (FP3) existed locally.

factor_2_feature_defaults_and_imputation.finding: Unobserved practice sessions were filled with constant 0.0 defaults (delta=0.0) and missing=1.0.
factor_2_feature_defaults_and_imputation.evidence: All 20 candidate rows for 33 races received identical placeholder values.

factor_3_constant_feature_columns.finding: In the historical training sets (r' < r), practice features had zero variance across 100% of rows.
factor_3_constant_feature_columns.evidence: Standardization computed std=1.0 (fallback for zero variance), producing standardized feature X_norm = 0.0.

factor_4_zero_fitted_coefficients.finding: L2 regularization strictly drove the model weights for zero-variance practice features to exactly 0.000000.
factor_4_zero_fitted_coefficients.evidence: With grad = X^T(p-y) + lambda*w = 0 + lambda*w = 0, the Newton step set w_practice = 0.0.

factor_5_incorrect_feature_column_mappin.finding: In controlled_ablation.py line 194, d_mask for Abu Dhabi practice was applied without driver_id filtering, overwriting all candidates with the last driver's delta.
factor_5_incorrect_feature_column_mappin.evidence: Additionally, FP2 laps/stints and FP3 laps/stints for Abu Dhabi were not mapped into build_controlled_feature_matrix.

factor_6_model_architecture.finding: Walk-forward linear logistic regression cannot learn a non-zero weight for a feature that was never observed in prior training rounds.
factor_6_model_architecture.evidence: Even at Abu Dhabi 2024, prior races 1..148 had no practice features, so the trained walk-forward model evaluated Abu Dhabi with w_practice = 0.0.

factor_7_genuine_lack_of_predictive_cont.finding: The conclusion in Phase 6.2 that practice features lacked predictive power was confounded by data absence and zero weights. It was an artifact of unobserved data, not a proved lack of predictive signal.

probability_vector_equality.finding: Across all 33 uncached races, P(T0), P(T1), P(T2), and P(T3) had bitwise identical probabilities down to machine epsilon (SHA-256 hashes match).
probability_vector_equality.proof: Since w_practice = 0.0, logits(T_k) = logits(T0) + 0*feat = logits(T0). Softmax produced identical probability simplexes.
